name: inferrail-web-read
description: Read web pages as clean Markdown with their dates, authors and a content hash. $0.002 per delivered page, from prepaid credits or your own wallet, under a daily budget.
long_description: Read public webpages and text-layer PDFs as Markdown with source metadata and a content hash. A delivered result costs $0.002. Source 0.3.2 exposes Web Read, known package vulnerability checks and domain infrastructure with a prepaid API key where those credit routes are active, or a funded x402 wallet on Base. Published 0.3.0 offers Web Read only in API-key mode. A person authorizes and funds the workspace or wallet first. Failed delivery is uncharged. Matching requests, request_id and payer/workspace can recover a paid result within 10 minutes. The local daily budget persists across restarts; it is not an account-wide cap across separate clients. Nothing here creates or funds a wallet.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: One public web page as clean Markdown with its metadata and content hash ($0.002, only when delivered).

tools.name: read_pages
tools.description: 1–10 public sources. Wallet mode is all-or-nothing; API-key mode reads individually and charges each successful delivery ($0.002 each).

tools.name: check_packages
tools.description: Up to 20 package versions checked for known vulnerabilities on OSV.dev ($0.002 per check).

tools.name: lookup_domain
tools.description: A domain's DNS records, SPF/DMARC and registration ($0.002 per lookup).

api_key.title: Inferrail API key (prepaid credits)
api_key.description: irw_... workspace key funded once by card. Pays $0.002 per page without a wallet. Use this or a wallet key.

wallet_key.title: Wallet private key
wallet_key.description: 0x... key of a separate wallet that holds only a little USDC on Base. It pays $0.002 per delivered result. Leave empty to try the tools without paying.

max_usd_per_day.title: Daily budget (USD)
max_usd_per_day.description: The most the extension pays per UTC day. A call that would go past it is refused before anything is signed.
